sourceDataset: MIT Election Data and Science Lab U.S. House 1976-2024
interpretation: Seat-vote gap is descriptive only. Values are calculated only for observed fully two-party-contested district datasets; additional per-year district completeness checks are needed.

records.limitations: Descriptive gap is not partisan bias, gerrymandering causality, or judicial evidence. Missing election districts and candidate-party coding may affect interpretation.
